headline: As of 2026-11-02: 58,063,572 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 58,063,572 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,750,975), California (6,406,161), Florida (5,456,393).
